## JOB CODE CODING

A basic Job Code Number, consisting of four (4) digits is assigned to each occupation. A fifth digit must be added to denote the grade of the occupation as follows:


<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Working Leader Sr.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Add 0</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Working Leader A.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Add 1</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Working Leader B.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Add 2</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>&quot;A&quot; Grade</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Add 3</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>&quot;B&quot; Grade</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Add 4</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>&quot;C&quot; Grade</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Add 5</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Senior Grade</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Add 6</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Trainee</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Add 8</td></tr></table>

For example, the basic code for the occupation of Assembler-Precision is 4155. The code for the classification, Assembler-Precision "A" is 41553; for the "B" grade, 41554, etc.

Where the "B" or "C" grades are not shown, these will be added when needed with applicable rate ranges below the "A" and "B" grades respectively.

## APPRENTICE SCHEDULE

The base rate for employees entering apprenticeship training is computed on the base rate range maximum then in effect for which the employee is serving an apprenticeship as follows:

Appren Supp Tech $1.54 below the maximum of Labor Grade 22

Appren Machinist $1.70 below the maximum of Labor Grade 22

Appren Tool and

Die Maker $1.70 below the maximum of Labor Grade 22
